p: land: In the land of Canaan.
Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the: In the tribe of Judah, which was also called Bethlehem Ephrathat, because there was another city so called in the tribe of Zebulun.
women of Moab: By this wonderful providence of God Ruth became one of God's household, of whom Christ came.
visited his people in giving them: By sending them plenty again.
rest: By this it appears that Naomi by dwelling among idolaters, had become cold to the true zeal of God, having more respect for the comfort of the body than the comfort of the soul.
kissed her mother in law: When she took leave and departed.
return thou after thy sister in: No persuasion can convince them to turn back from God, if he has chosen them to be his.
moved about them: By which it appears that she was of a great family of good reputation.
barley harvest: Which was in the month of Nisan, that is, part March and part April.
